lastResponse.text: That’s a great question, and it’s easy to mix up. The housing legal counselor is mainly for legal advice and reviewing your eviction paper and deadlines. For back rent help, ask for eviction prevention assistance. So, two lanes: legal counselor for the notice, eviction prevention assistance for rent support. I can connect you to the right person now.
